top_signals.title: F1 Reviews China Boy Band’s Logo for Similarities: Global Times
top_signals.summary: The Formula One group is reviewing and investigating information about a logo used in a concert tour by Chinese boy group Teens in Times, after fans alleged it resembled F1’s trademark, the Global Times reported on Sunday.

top_signals.title: Mexican Governor Wanted by US Over Cartel Ties Seeks Leave Again
top_signals.summary: The Mexican governor accused by the US of conspiring with a cartel and abetting drug trafficking has once again requested leave, after returning to his post on Friday.
